FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN connected AS T2

INNER JOIN bond AS T3
  ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE
  T3.bond_type = '-';

SELECT
  ((SUM(CASE WHEN T1.date = '1998-12-27' THEN T1.balance ELSE NULL END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T1.date = '1993-03-22' THEN T1.balance ELSE NULL END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN T1.date = '1993-03-22' THEN T1.balance ELSE NULL END)) * 100.0
FROM trans AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2
  ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
INNER JOIN loan AS T3
  ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
INNER JOIN client AS T4
  ON T2.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE
  T3.date = '1993-07-05' AND T1.account_id = (
    SELECT
      T2.account_id
    FROM account AS T2
    INNER JOIN disp AS T3
      ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
    INNER JOIN client AS T4
      ON T2.district_id = T4.district_id
    WHERE
      T3.client_id = (
        SELECT
          client_id
        FROM client
        INNER JOIN disp AS T5
          ON client.client_id = T5.client_id
        WHERE
          T5.account_id = T2.account_id
      )
  )
  AND T1.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27');
SELECT T1.artist FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN sets AS T2 ON T1.mcmId = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Coldsnap' AND T1.artist IN ('Jeremy Jarvis', 'Aaron Miller', 'Chippy')

SELECT
  T1.Segment,
  (
    (T1.Consumption - T2.Consumption) * 100.0 / T1.Consumption
  ) AS percentage_increase
FROM yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2
  ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE
  T2.Currency = 'EUR' AND T1.Date IN ('201212', '201312')
  AND T1.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT
      CustomerID
    FROM customers
    WHERE
      Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  )
GROUP BY
  T1.Segment
ORDER BY
  percentage_increase DESC
LIMIT 1
UNION ALL
SELECT
  T1.Segment,
  (
    (T1.Consumption - T2.Consumption) * 100.0 / T1.Consumption
  ) AS percentage_increase
FROM yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2
  ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE
  T2.Currency = 'EUR' AND T1.Date IN ('201212', '201312')
  AND T1.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT
      CustomerID
    FROM customers
    WHERE
      Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  )
GROUP BY
  T1.Segment
ORDER BY
  percentage_increase ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH RaceData AS (
  -- 1. Find the raceId for the "2008 Australian Grand Prix"
  SELECT
    T1.raceId,
    T1.name
  FROM races AS T1
  WHERE
    T1.year = 2008 AND T1.name LIKE '%Australian Grand Prix%'
),
ChampionDriver AS (
  -- 3. Find the driver who finished in the best position (champion)
  SELECT
    T2.driverId,
    T2.position
  FROM driverStandings AS T2
  JOIN RaceData AS T1
    ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId
  ORDER BY
    T2.position ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
LastDriver AS (
  -- 2. Find the driver who finished last
  SELECT
    T2.driverId,
    T2.position
  FROM driverStandings AS T2
  JOIN RaceData AS T1
    ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId
  ORDER BY
    T2.position DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
ChampionTime AS (
  -- 4. Retrieve the finishing time for the champion (using results.time)
  SELECT
    T1.time
  FROM results AS T1
  JOIN ChampionDriver AS T2
    ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId AND T1.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM RaceData)
  WHERE
    T1.statusId = (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status = 'Finished')
    AND T1.time IS NOT NULL
),
LastDriverTime AS (
  -- 4. Retrieve the finishing time for the last-place driver
  SELECT
    T1.time
  FROM results AS T1
  JOIN LastDriver AS T2
    ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId AND T1.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM RaceData)
  WHERE
    T1.statusId = (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status = 'Finished')
    AND T1.time IS NOT NULL
)

INNER JOIN molecule AS T2
  ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
INNER JOIN bond AS T3
  ON T1.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id
WHERE
  T3.bond_type = '-' AND T1.element = 'o';

SELECT
  T1.translation
FROM set_translations AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2
  ON T1.setCode = T2.code
WHERE
  T2.name = 'Eighth Edition' AND T1.language = 'Chinese Simplified';

SELECT
  T2.DisplayName
FROM votes AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2
  ON T1.UserId = T2.Id
WHERE
  T1.Id = 6347;

SELECT
  COUNT(T1.id)
FROM sets AS T1
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2
  ON T1.code = T2.setCode
WHERE
  T2.language = 'Italian' AND T1.baseSetSize < 100;

SELECT
  T1.event_name
FROM event AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2
  ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event
WHERE
  T2.category = 'Advertisement'
GROUP BY
  T1.event_name
ORDER BY
  SUM(T2.spent) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  GROUP_CONCAT(T1.id)
FROM cards AS T1
WHERE
  T1.isStorySpotlight = 1 AND T1.isTextless = 0;

SELECT
  T1.text
FROM rulings AS T1
INNER JOIN cards AS T2
  ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T3
  ON T2.setCode = T3.setCode
WHERE
  T3.language = 'Italian' AND T2.setCode = 'Coldsnap';

SELECT
  T1.lat,
  T1.lng
FROM circuits AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2
  ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId
WHERE
  T2.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix';

SELECT
  T1.Id,
  T2.DisplayName
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2
  ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreaionDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY
  T1.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT
  T1.Time
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2
  ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
WHERE
  T2.ChainID = 11;

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Consumption > 46.73 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID)
FROM yearmonth AS T1
INNER JOIN customers AS T2
  ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE
  T2.Segment = 'LAM';

SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1980' AND T1.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND T1.SEX = 'F';

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T2.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN sets AS T2
  ON T1.mtgoId = T2.mcmId
WHERE
  T1.name = 'Angel of Mercy' AND T2.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  T1.Title,
  T1.Body,
  AVG(T1.ViewCount)
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN tags AS T2
  ON T1.Id = T2.ExcerptPostId
WHERE
  T2.TagName = 'humor'
GROUP BY
  T1.Id;

SELECT
  T1.time
FROM lapTimes AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2
  ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
INNER JOIN circuits AS T3
  ON T2.circuitId = T3.circuitId
WHERE
  T3.country = 'Italy';

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2
  ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE
  STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956' AND T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DisplayName = 'Mornington' THEN T1.ViewCount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.DisplayName = 'Amos' THEN T1.ViewCount ELSE 0 END)
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2
  ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE
  T2.DisplayName IN ('Mornington', 'Amos');

SELECT
  COUNT(T1.Id)
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2
  ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE
  T2.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini';

SELECT
  MAX(T1.Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17) / T1.Enrollment (Ages 5-17))
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2
  ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE
  CAST(T2.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T2.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT T1.driverId)
FROM driverStandings AS T1
INNER JOIN races AS T2
  ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE
  T2.year = 2008 AND T2.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix';
